comments: Deployment-SoC-resolution experiment: same architecture as kuralsnet_npu_seg.json (bottleneck_ch=64) but trained on the RD map block max-pooled down to (8 Doppler, 64 Range) -- the fixed RD buffer size of a smaller target SoC (see kurals/dataset_process/kuralscw_processing.py --doppler-bins/--range-bins and resize_extracted_dataset.py). Same hyperparameters as the native-resolution run so resolution is the only changed variable. Bottleneck feature map at this input size collapses to (1, 8) spatially (ALIGN=8 leaves zero headroom on the Doppler axis) -- baseline to compare against the widened bottleneck_ch variant trained on the same data.
